meta.dataset: US LLC state government fees for the Epics Deals MCP tools
meta.notes: formation_fee_usd is the one-time state filing fee for the Articles/Certificate of Organization (standard, non-expedited, online where offered). annual_fee_usd is the recurring state charge per filing cycle (report fee or flat annual tax). verified=true means the row was checked against the state's own published fee schedule or Epics Deals' own verified state facts (2026-11-08); verified=false rows are cross-checked across at least two established 2026 references that cite Secretary of State data, and tools must say so honestly. State fees change — Epics Deals confirms the exact fee before filing.
